description: This Java class functions as a property editor for PersonAttributeType objects within the OpenMRS framework, enabling serialization/deserialization for web forms and supporting object retrieval by ID and UUID.

classes.name: PersonAttributeTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting between PersonAttributeType objects and their string representations in web forms, supporting retrieval by ID and UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by its ID using the OpenMRS person service.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by its UUID using the OpenMRS person service.
